C1530.title: GitHub - avechuch0/telegram-bigbang: Monitor collections of malicious Telegram bots
C1530.summary: The GitHub project avechuch0/telegram-bigbang is used to monitor malicious Telegram bots used for phishing and credential theft. Its goal is to identify related bot activity to help prevent fraud and data leakage. Claims about deleting data or exact incidentTime should be supported with README, code evidence, or project commit timestamp sources.
